purpose: Candidate dependency closure evidence; not an approved project lockfile.

gap_closure_review.method: Direct checks against official npm/Git/Go registries, reproducible clean-archive Go builds, deterministic scratch-image rebuilds, and image SBOM inspection. This records evidence only and does not alter the user-approved candidate snapshot or lock.
gap_closure_review.toolchain: go1.27.3 darwin/arm64; Docker Engine 29.8.2 OrbStack linux/arm64; Syft 1.52.0 Homebrew for exploratory image scan; official Syft 1.56.0 Darwin arm64 archive checksum independently matched candidate metadata, but that binary was not successfully installed for this review.

Installed OrbStack docker-tools is signed by Orbital Labs and hashes to 927c58aed356a37f08f2586a90df4c6d8c5e890060de95ac3d11301d03959463; this proves publisher signature, not Docker upstream provenance. Clean Go 1.27.3 builds reproduced linux/amd64 SHA-256 42541aea0fed0ced50b8aea23e9225b93592519ca5b3c8c4d7c7885cfb334763 and linux/arm64 SHA-256 bba5a773e78e212df3286c21d514341aab20e0104b836570bdbb8ff30a2a33c3. gap_closure_review.decision: The seven-row gap is not closed. PostgreSQL and Valkey current images conflict with the permissive-only policy; SWC compound license classification and host-tool provenance need resolution; SQLite, scratch image and the repository fixture now have reproducible supporting evidence. No version lock is changed.

findings: Go module graph includes dependency test requirements; production/test target closure is separately counted.
Vite 8 was rejected because lightningcss is MPL-2.0; Vite 7.3.7 is the current candidate.
The current license policy still requires explicit decisions for non-allowlisted npm metadata such as CC-BY-4.0, BlueOak-1.0.0, MIT-0 and Apache-2.0 AND MIT composites.
No project go.sum, package lock, image SBOM or final SPDX classification is created by this report.
